text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — onboarding Polaris LoRA from customer:packed-polaris. I ran the merge script; artifacts in s3://rwd-inference/customer-polaris/merges/1743219876
Teddy Park: thanks — can you drop the exact commit + diff? also which tokenizer did they ship?
Maria Chen: commit f3a9b2c, diff link https://git.internal/polaris/merge/12345
Maria Chen: tokenizer is a slightly modified byte-level BPE (their tokenizer.json attached) — mapping for <amount> token looks shifted.
Jing Wu: kicked off a quickpack eval (int8 + fp16 baselines) — I'll paste the run command
Jing Wu: ```
rdi eval-run --model polaris-lora-merged --suite quickpack --quant int8 --output=/tmp/polaris-qpack.log
``` 
eval-bot: evaluation started (run id rEVAL-1743219876) — ETA ~9m
Jing Wu: initial pass: most prompts OK, but amount extraction falls from 0.92 -> 0.78 (int8). Examples show tokenized numbers split oddly.
Samir Patel: can you paste a failing example? might be tokenization leading to off-by-one in KV caching mapping
Jing Wu: failing case:
Jing Wu: "Invoice total: $12,345.67" -> model outputs "12 , 345 . 67"
Jing Wu: token IDs (short): [101, 2023, 764, 11, 3399, 1432]
Olivia Grant: could be a tokenizer vocab mismatch between base model and adapter — did we remap special tokens during merge?
Maria Chen: we used the merge tool with --remap-tokens auto; there's a remap table at s3://rwd-inference/customer-polaris/remap/remap-1743219876.json
Samir Patel: quick check — if we re-run merge with --preserve-vocab should we expect exact mapping? maybe worth trying
Teddy Park: also try running just prefix KV warmstart to see if cache offsets change the outputs
Jing Wu: rerunning with preserve-vocab + int8; eval started
eval-bot: evaluation rEVAL-1743219876-2 started
Jing Wu: update: preserve-vocab fixed most numeric token splits, amount extraction now 0.90 (vs 0.92 baseline). There's still a subtle hallucination for currency symbols in paired locales.
Maria Chen: great. Plan: 1) push a re-merge preserving vocab, 2) add a tokenizer-mapping test to quickpack, 3) include locale-specific currency prompts in eval suite.
Olivia Grant: +1. I'll add the testcases and PR the eval-suite changes.
Samir Patel: tagging @infra for a short smoke deploy to dedicated pool after we promote
Teddy Park: noted — I'll coordinate a canary window Tue 10am PT
Maria Chen: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update customer and attach results/next steps
